feeds.title: Quietly Saving
feeds.description: I'm Weenie. In 2014, I came across the term FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early). I set up this blog, devised a plan, began to save more and invest.I try to balance enjoying my life in the present while attempting to plan for the future. My plan is to be in a position to not have to work full-time (or at all) by 2025 (or 2024, depending on whether I want to do 'one more year').This blog is not a 'how-to' guide and doesn't give advice, it's just a journal documenting my progress, plus some of my occasionally mad thoughts and ideas.

feeds.title: Retirement Investing Today
feeds.description: RetirementInvestingToday analyses the economic data, market data and and investing strategies that I am using to reach Early Retirement. Our mission is to achieve Early Retirement by maximising salary contributions, minimising fees, minimising taxes, maximising return through tactical allocations and minimising investing mistakes.

feeds.title: Financial Independence Campaign Blog
feeds.description: A journey to financial independence in the UK. My strategy is simple: 1. invest in yourself (myself!); 2. spend intentionally; 3. invest like it's going out of fashion. All of the blog posts for a UK person journeying to Financial Independence Retire Early (FIRE). How can you achieve FIRE in the UK?

feeds.title: FatFIRE Blog
feeds.description: A UK Dad's journey to a comfortable Financial Independence and FatFIRE with two kids and middle-class expenses. A DAD'S GUIDE TO EARLY RETIREMENT WITH ALL THE TRIMMINGS.

feeds.title: theFIREstarter
feeds.description: Financial Independence and Early Retirement blog. Read about life hacks, money saving tips, frugal food, general views on life and of course the occasional rant.

feeds.title: Having Fun Cracking Retirement
feeds.description: Articles on retirement planning, retired life, travel, health and everything related to retirement. I took early retirement in 2011, having just turned 56. Over the past 5 years, I have been making the most of all the free time that retirement brings. I'm fortunate enough to be healthy and also have enough money to indulge my passions of travel, investing and working with metal of all shapes and styles.

feeds.title: My Money Yard
feeds.description: Monethalia offers advice on how to make the most of your matched betting journey, ways to gain some extra cash and change your attitude towards money. I am on a journey to retire in 10 years (in my 40s) and I will show you how you can achieve this as well.

feeds.title: Fire And Wide
feeds.description: Financial Freedom - Buying Time For Living Life. Quitting the rat race, spending your time on what matters to you. No magic answers or unicorns.

feeds.title: I Retired Young
feeds.description: I retired young, at 47. I'm blogging how much it costs to live and what I do with my extra free time in case this helps with your own decision to retire early.

feeds.title: My Deliberate Life
feeds.description: A blog on early retirement and philosophical living in the UK.
